_meta.grade_legend: S=search summary only, D=attached PDF statement/diagram, P=primary doc/patent checked, V=verified on actual vehicle, T=bake/preview verified
_meta.status_legend: LOCK=production value, HOLD=number known but not approved, CONCEPT=plausible proportion only, never shown as a measurement

axes.head_B: instance of head_A rotated 180 deg about world Z (point symmetry, no mirror)
axes.rotation_sign: +theta = counter-clockwise seen from head-local +Z looking down

test_B_scharfenberg.bake_note: 150F = shot 10, plus 30F post-roll so the G3 window [E-60,E+59] fits

front_plate_half_width.source: D (PDF p4 One4 head, proportion only)

pivot_setback.source: D (PDF p4: central vertical main pin)
pivot_setback.note: distance from front plate face to main pin, along -y

plate_radius.source: P-candidate US2161724 (hook plate core), proportion only
plate_radius.note: core disc radius; hook lobe added on top

link_pin_radius.source: D (PDF p4 link pin on plate)

link_pin_angle_ready_deg.note: angle of link pin from local +y about pivot when plate is at theta=0 (ready)

notch_angle_deg.note: angle of hook notch from local +y about pivot at theta=0

link_length.source: derived by kin_schB from loop closure at theta_lock

link_guide_x.note: link passes through the cone axis at the front plate (guide point G)

spring_anchor.source: D (PDF p4 tension spring to housing bracket)
spring_anchor.note: local xy of spring housing anchor

hook_lobe.source: P-candidate US2161724 / PDF p4 'hook notch on the rim', proportion only
hook_lobe.note: cam radius rho(a)=core+height*0.5*(1+cos(pi*(a-center)/half_width)) inside |a-center|<=half_width, except the notch cut |a-notch_angle|<=notch_cut_half_width where rho=notch_radius. Partner link tip rides this cam, drops into the cut.

theta_lock_deg.source: CONCEPT: spring fully returned at lock

gap_start.note: face-to-face gap at local F1; cone already inside funnel (SCH_CONE_ENTRY happens in shot 09)

motion.approach_profile: smoothstep on gap from gap_start to 0 between F1 and F_locked-6

snap_frames.note: frames for the spring snap from max deflection to lock

post_lock_tension_pull.note: m, micro pull of head B along +y after lock to show the closed loop under tension

deflection_sign.source: CONCEPT: chosen by grid search (96 combos, 6 all-pass); tip climbs the lobe flank, plate pushed back CW, spring returns CCW

camera._source: elevation: R8 §5 top view >=60 (LOCK); lens/distance CONCEPT framing
